newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Thailand to get BIS advice on supervision.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Thailand to get BIS advice on supervision.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand, in an effort to bolster supervision of financial institutions, will seek recommendations and guidelines from the Basel-based Bank of International Settlement (BIS), a central bank official said.
The central bank will hold an annual meeting with the BIS this June, after which the BIS was expected to send experts to advise the central bank, he told Reuters on Monday.

The official said the move was part of an ongoing process to improve the efficiency of the central bank in general, and to prepare the organisation for a more complicated and competitive financial sector.
Thailand last month ordered a major revamp of its troubled financial sector, which has been hit by a severe liquidity crunch and billions of dollars in sour loans to the depressed property sector.
"We look to BIS for advice to improve the supervisions and development system of Thai financial institutions because BIS is well-experience and knowledgeable in the field," he said.
The statement followed a report that the International Monetary Fund had suggested it enhance banking supervision given the financial sector's increased vulnerability to non-performing loans.
